figures.finding: German directors' pay floors are joint remuneration rules (Gemeinsame Vergütungsregeln, § 36 UrhG) that the Bundesverband Regie has agreed since 2013 with broadcasters, Netflix and the producers' associations; their fees count as the 'appropriate' pay the copyright act requires.
figures.applies: Germany, directors covered by each rule (usually BVR members) and the broadcaster, streamer or producers' association that signed it.

sources.said: Der Bundesverband Regie e.V. hat auf der Grundlage von § 36 UrhG seit 2013 mehrere Vergütungsregeln mit Sendern und der Produzentenallianz verhandelt und abgeschlossen. Die in diesen Vergütungsregeln vereinbarten Honorarbedingungen gelten als angemessen im Sinne von § 32 UrhG.

figures.finding: Under the BVR / Produzentenallianz / Produzentenverband rule for cinema features (21 September 2022) a director's base fee runs by budget from €27,500 (low-low budget) through €33,500 (from €0.8M), €38,500 (€1M), €47,500 (€1.2M), €57,500 (€1.5M), €62,500 (€2M), €85,000 (€3M), €105,000 (€4M) and €130,000 (€6M) to €160,000 from €8M, plus escalators and profit share.

value.budgetIs: production cost at start of shoot, or the funding decision's budget

figures.applies: Germany, fiction cinema features of 90 minutes or more by producers in the Produzentenallianz or Produzentenverband with BVR-member directors; documentaries, animation and film-school films excluded.

figures.finding: For ARD/Degeto fiction of 90 minutes the director's initial fee is €63,000 (2023), €64,000 (2024) and €65,000 (from 2025) for 420 usage points, each further point €120; a 60-minute fairy-tale film pays €46,000 / €46,600 / €47,400; ARD stations may instead buy a small package of 180 points for €35,300 / €36,000 / €36,700.
figures.applies: Germany, fully or partly financed fiction commissions of the ARD stations and Degeto, about 90 minutes (and 60-minute FSK 0 fairy-tale films), director contracts from 1 January 2023.

figures.finding: Under the Netflix / BVR / ver.di rule (1 July 2025 to 31 December 2030) an experienced director's minimum per series episode of about 45 minutes is €37,000 above a €1.35M episode budget, €42,000 above €1.8M, €46,000 above €2.7M and €50,000 above €3.6M.
figures.applies: Germany, Netflix series productions with first shooting day from 1 July 2025 within the term; not retroactive.

sources.said: NETFLIX verpflichtet sich zur Zahlung der nachfolgenden MINDESTVERGÜTUNG pro Episode für ERFAHRENE REGISSEUR*INNEN. … 1,35 Mio. 37.000 1,8 Mio. 42.000 2,7 Mio. 46.000 3,6 Mio. 50.000 für eine durchschnittliche Dauer von 45 min (plus/minus 10 min). … Die Laufzeit dieser REGIE GVR beginnt mit dem 1. Juli 2025 und endet mit dem 31. Dezember 2030.

figures.finding: The Bundesverband Regie (over 600 members) admits directors after its board reviews their filmography; dues are €60 a month for fiction film and TV directors with two features or equivalent episodes, €30 for documentary or independent directors, €25 for emerging directors and €10 for film students.

sources.said: Der Regieverband ist mit über 600 Mitgliedern die größte Vereinigung von Film-und Fernsehregisseur:innen … Der Vorstand des Regieverbands prüft deine Vita und Filmographie und trifft die Entscheidung in welcher Mitgliedskategorie du tatsächlich aufgenommen wirst.

abendfüllenden Langfilmen oder einer entsprechenden Anzahl an Serienfolgen beträgt 60,- € / Monat … Der reguläre Mitgliedsbeitrag für Nachwuchsregisseure/-regisseurinnen beträgt monatlich 25,- €. … Der reguläre Mitgliedsbeitrag für Studierende beträgt monatlich 10,- €.

figures.finding: Under the Netflix rule, a director paid at or near the minimum covers the usual prep and post work and up to 13 shoot days per episode (episode budget €1.35-2.7M) or 15 (above €2.7M); further shoot days are paid by Netflix at €2,000 or €2,500 a day.

value.prepAndPost: customary preparation and post-production included, no days set
value.condition: contracted fee not substantially above the minimum

figures.applies: Germany, Netflix German-language series under the Regie GVR Netflix (productions with first shoot day 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2030).
